Analytical and results-driven Business Analyst with over 10.9 years of experience in the banking and financial services sector. Proven expertise in Avaloq, analyzing, designing, and optimizing payment systems including SWIFT, SEPA, FPS, CHAPS, BACS, and ISO 20022 messaging. Skilled in requirements gathering, Vendor and Stakeholder management, and driving digital transformation across cross-border and domestic payments. Adapt at working in Agile and Waterfall environments and collaborating across business, IT, Risk, Regulatory and compliance teams

Summary • Holding 10.9 years of experience as Business Analyst - KYC Account opening, AML/KYC, Customer Screening, Fraud Investigation, Transaction Monitoring, End to End Corporate KYC in FCC Operations, Risk and compliance, ATM Operations, Account Maintenance, Sanctions screening, Correspondent Banking, Swift Payments. Certified Anti Money –Laundering specialist May 2018 - ER- 000094990. Certified Anti Money –Laundering Investigator (CAMI) April 2018. Certified Functional Business Analyst- March 2022. Working as Lead- BA, Correspondent banking, Private Banking operations, with Mashreq Global Services, Bangalore from August 2022 till 13th Feb 2026.

processes across corporate and retail banking segments.

Worked with compliance teams to translate regulatory requirements (e.g., AMLD5, FATF, FinCEN) into

Coordinated UAT planning and execution for KYC modules, including client risk scoring, document verification, and case management.

Worked closely with investigations teams to improve alert quality, investigation turnaround time, and
